/-- Key bound: for any supergraph `H ≥ G` on a finite vertex set, the number of edges added
  is at most the number of vertices. (In particular, ≤ `n`.) -/
lemma erdos_619.variants.addedEdges_le_card {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {G H : SimpleGraph V}
    (h : G ≤ H) : (H \ G).edgeSet.ncard ≤ Fintype.card V := by
  have h₀ : (H \ G).edgeSet ≤ H.edgeSet := by
    intro e; exact (H.diff G).le_left e
  have h₁ : (H \ G).edgeSet.ncard ≤ (H.edgeSet : Set (V × V)).ncard :=
    Set.ncard_le_ncard (h₀ : (H \ G).edgeSet ≤ (H.edgeSet : Set (V × V)))
  have h₂ : (H.edgeSet : Set (V × V)).ncard ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    convert Set.ncard_le_univ (H.edgeSet : Set (V × V)) using 1
    <;> simp [Fintype.card_Volt]
  exact le_trans h₁ h₂
